notes.title: Major update v1.0.5 to the gameplay mechanics and some balancing
notes.content:
- Added the option to disable/enable a block in direct placement mode. Disabling a block dims the block with a red strike over it. This aids with better visualization at bigger complex levels. Blocks can be disabled via mouse right click or L-CTRL key.

- The notoriously difficult absorber blocks will only absorb the values of the directly adjacent blocks around it. It will not absorb any blocks beyond 1 grid unit distance.

- Store achievements delay bug fix.

- Total blocks for the direct placement mode slightly reduced.

notes.title: Patch#4 Bugfixes
notes.content:
- Visual bug fixes in the block types of negator,xy adder and distance block.
- Fixed the bug where sometimes level like 21 self negates into having 0 signals
- Added a minor credits sequence when finishing the final level instead of just normally going back to the level selection.
- Fixed a bug where final set of symbols show up as octopus in the gameplay screen.

notes.title: Quick Hotfix #3 (Mac only)
notes.content:
- Updated to same build as windows
- Fixed the clunky nature of the undo button. Now the undo will work as intended.
- Fixed a logical mistake where the absorber block doesn't absorb in the value of a counter block altered by an equalizer.

notes.title: Demo build v0.2 patch & update based on player feedback
notes.content:
The demo build update (v0.2) was released which has some drastic changes and improvements to the demo.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44027522/cbc2ded9840f9c92550385a3934d79fba661e0a6.png[/img]


[list]

[*] Removed all physical position altering block types like the falling block from the game completely to focus only on it's core concept. The demo has the falling block replaced with a new equalizer block type.

[*] Level arrangements are altered a bit to promote a smoother and fair difficulty curve.

[*] Added an optional 1-minute cool down "tip button" in the gameplay menu. Clicking on the tip button temporarily highlights a couple of blocks that are in their correct positions.

[*] Fixed frame rate issue in the main menu screen.

[*] Added an option in the settings to enable/disable auto submission of levels. Auto-submission is turned on by default. Disabling auto-submission shows a submit button in the gameplay screen which the player can manually click and complete whenever all the signals are solved. Auto-submission will automatically complete the level whenever all the signals are solved.

[*] Minor bug fixes related to the settings.

[/list]
